sloka: विविधानि विशालानि ददृशुः ते समन्ततः ।हेम रजत कांस्यानाम् भाजनानाम् च राशयः ॥४-५०-३४॥
transliteration: vividhāni viśālāni dadṛśuḥ te samantataḥ ।hema rajata kāṁsyānām bhājanānām ca rāśayaḥ ॥4-50-34॥

translations.english: They saw all over rich collections of beds, couches and highly valuable vehicles, decorated beautifully with gems and gold.They also saw a large collection of shining utensils made of gold, silver and bronze.
